implemented_requirements.requirement: Puzzle is named 'Strands' and has a title/theme/hint
Multiple strands of text are provided for the player
implemented_requirements.evidence: models.Strand class and StrandsGame creates a list of Strand objects from puzzle["strands"]
models.Answer class and StrandsGame creates a list of Answer objects from puzzle["answers"]
Only a placeholder call to self._can_partition(...) with ellipsis is present; no verification logic is implemented

implemented_requirements.requirement: Program confirms completion once all strands are correctly merged
implemented_requirements.evidence: No method or state transition that checks all answers are solved; solved_answers list is never updated

implemented_requirements.requirement: Feedback is offered on valid merges (similar to NYT Strands)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No method that returns or prints feedback after a merge attempt

implemented_requirements.requirement: User can select and merge strands
implemented_requirements.evidence: No merge or selection handling code; utils.parse_selection is defined but never used

critical_issues: Core game logic (merging strands, validating merges, providing feedback) is missing; only class skeletons are present.
Placeholder ellipsis ("...") in StrandsGame.__init__ prevents code from running; _can_partition is undefined.
No import statements or module wiring; game cannot be executed as provided.
No entry point or UI/CLI to interact with the puzzle.
judge.summary: The repository contains only skeletal class definitions and data structures without any of the essential gameplay mechanics required by the benchmark. While strands and answers are modeled, there is no implementation for merging, validation, feedback, or completion detection, and the code contains placeholders that would cause runtime errors. Consequently, the solution does not meet the core functional requirements and is unlikely to be executable.
